lead: Historical standings of a real contest, shown as ghost rows in the replay and the virtual board.
unsupported: Final-submission contests do not support ghosts: scores exist only after the final judging.

import.title: Import ghosts from CSV
import.lead: Columns: label, caption, then one column per problem code. A cell is empty, minute, minute+wrong tries, points{'@'}minute or points{'@'}minute+wrong tries. The file is 1 MiB at most.
import.anonymizeHint: Rename labels to Ghost 001, Ghost 002…: labels may be real students' names and everyone who sees the board sees them.
import.refusedTruncated: Only the first {count} errors are shown.

rowCodes.label_invalid: The label is too long (64 characters at most).
rowCodes.caption_invalid: The caption is too long (64 characters at most).
rowCodes.control_character: The row has a control character.
rowCodes.cell_invalid: A score cell has the wrong syntax.
rowCodes.columns_mismatch: The column count differs from the header.
rowCodes.csv_invalid: The file is not valid CSV.

import.stored: Stored {count} ghosts. The replay will be rebuilt.
import.confirmBody: The current set will be replaced by the {next} ghosts in the file. Download the current CSV first to keep it.
